correctness.rationale: For N>=5 the deleted-character support is exactly two, three, or four sites depending on lag; the resulting Fourier polynomials are 1+u, 1+u+u^2, or (1+u)(1+v). K=0 ambiguity never vanishes. Exact congruence counts give H_N, d solutions to u=-1, (q/2)J_d intersection, and 4d primitive-cube-root zeros, with the q=2 exceptional lag treated separately. By Goldberger--Kang--Okoudjou Theorem 1 the count equals rank deficiency. The packaged standard-library checker independently calculates integer residues modulo cyclotomic polynomials for all 589 pairs 5<=N<=35 and agrees exactly. It is finite corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full-rank threshold for a natural two-dead-coordinate constant Gabor measurement fiducial has a subtle arithmetic dependence on the deleted-site separation. The complete classification for all cyclic orders, not a chosen numerical slice, identifies a sharp 3-torsion obstruction in odd dimensions and both 2-torsion obstructions and exact multiplicities in even dimensions. In composite odd order 15, changing only the two-hole spacing switches exact linear informational completeness and produces distinct rank deficits 0, 4, and 20. This is a motivated exact structured measurement invariant useful in selecting fiducial masks, without claiming a general conditioning theorem or paper-sized contribution.
